name: api-gateway-s3-sam
description: SAM Example 2: API Gateway + S3 Integration

scripts.test:localstack: AWS_REGION=us-west-2 ITEMS_TABLE=api-s3-fileupload-local DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4566 S3_LOCAL_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4566 node test/localstack.test.js
scripts.test:aws-lambda: bash -c 'ENDPOINT=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name api-s3-fileupload-sam-dev --region us-west-2 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[0].OutputValue" --output text 2>/dev/null) && if [ ! -z "$ENDPOINT" ] && [ "$ENDPOINT" != "None" ]; then export API_ENDPOINT="$ENDPOINT" && bash test/aws-lambda.test.sh; else echo "❌ API endpoint not found. Deploy the stack first: npm run deploy-dev"; exit 1; fi'
scripts.test:all: npm run test:localstack && npm run test:sam-local && npm run test:aws-lambda
